page.overview:
Who is Astrelle?

Astrelle is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

In the White Tower, Alviarin hears her discussing statistical methods relating to the failing of the Keepings on the food storerooms in the Tower.
